summary: Feed s122_double to NDR is degraded: 50% of packets missing required VLAN 20 (tags stripped) and 93.5% encrypted traffic exceeds NDR 90% tolerance, reducing detection coverage despite no duplicates, drops, overload or one-way issues.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding trunk VLAN 20; 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is completely absent while NDR requires VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses visibility into VLAN 20 segment - misses lateral movement and segmentation violations, correlation by VLAN fails, detection coverage halved for that zone.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker ingress and egress to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward VLANs 10 and 20 to this NDR tool port so required segmentation context is restored.

findings.root_cause: 94% of bytes are TLS/encrypted, above the NDR's 90% tolerance; traffic is almost entirely opaque without a decryption point before the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep inspection and behavioral detection; with 93.5% encrypted, payload analysis, JA3, and threat detection are severely limited leading to missed encrypted C2/exfiltration.

recommended_fix.why: Advise selective TLS decryption or mirror decrypted traffic via packet broker SSL visibility solution; alternatively feed metadata-enriched decrypted copy to NDR while keeping privacy/compliance controls.
